findings.text: SEPARATION OF DUTIES DORMANT + FAILS OPEN. warp.request/v1 defines no producer/proposer field; is_authorized derives separation solely from req.get('producer') = always None on a real record, so a self-approval by the actual proposer returns authorized=True. A safety authorizer must FAIL CLOSED when the identity needed for a load-bearing property is absent. Fix: use a VERIFIED proposer identity supplied by the W5 edge (never a self-declared request field), and REFUSE when it is absent. Add a producerless-request negative selftest.

NON-LIST impact DROPS TWO-KEY. needs_2k uses _as_list(impact) which coerces a scalar (impact='irreversible') to [] => needs_2k False => irreversible/money/external authorizes with no second key. Fix: treat a non-list/malformed impact as fail-closed, not 'no two-key needed'. Add a scalar-impact negative.

PER-REQUEST BYPASS ON NULL id: rid=None matches an attestation with absent/None request_id (None==None) => a blanket attestation authorizes an idless request. Refuse a request with no id; never treat null request_id as a per-request match.

risk_acceptance == string 'false' accepted as acceptance (_is_str('false') True); parse_yamlish turns unquoted false into 'false'. Normalize risk_acceptance through _as_bool and reject anything resolving to False.

min_independence defaults to per-identity groups when the registry omits 'independence' (grp=who), so undeclared independence is treated as independent (fail-open for the independence guarantee). Default conservatively or require an explicit group when min_independence > 1.

must_fix_before_live: Separation of duties enforceable + fail-closed: is_authorized uses a VERIFIED proposer identity supplied by the W5 edge (not a self-declared req field), and REFUSES when it is absent. Add a producerless-request negative selftest.
Non-list/malformed impact is fail-closed on the two-key path (do not coerce to [] and drop the second key). Add a scalar-impact negative.
Refuse a request with no id; kill the None==None per-request match. Add an idless-request negative.
Reject risk_acceptance resolving to False via _as_bool (including string 'false').
min_independence default must not silently treat undeclared independence as independent.
